title: Annotations
intro: The only annotation keys catalog files may carry — values stay free-form. Administrators define each allowed key and the entity kinds it applies to.
loadFailed: Could not load the annotation keys

field.keyHint: Optional lowercase domain prefix, a slash, then the name — e.g. github.com/project-slug
field.kindsHint: Only files of these kinds may carry this annotation

validation.key: Must be an optional lowercase-domain prefix plus a 1–63 character name of letters, digits, and single [-_.] separators

saveConflict: An annotation key with this name already exists
saveInvalid: One or more fields are invalid
saveGone: This annotation key no longer exists — reload the page
deleteFailed: Could not delete the annotation key
deleteBody: Files carrying "{{key}}" will not save until the key is re-registered or removed from them.
